text: 。Examples of drug interactions with dietary supplements …药物与膳食补充剂相互作用的实例：Vitamin E维生素ETaking vitamin E with a blood-thinning medication such as Coumadin can increase anti-clotting activity and may cause an increased risk of bleeding.维生素E与血液稀释剂（如：香豆素）同时服用会增加抗凝血活性，导致增加出血的风险。Ginseng人参This herb can interfere with the bleeding effects of Coumadin. In addition, ginseng can enhance the bleeding effects of heparin, aspirin, and nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs such as ibuprofen, naproxen, and ketoprofen. Combining ginseng with MAO inhibitors such as Nardil or Parnate may cause headache, trouble sleeping, nervousness, and hyperactivity.这种药草能干扰香豆素的出血作用
